Recorded claim:
The Address Book adapter starts one search per directory and tracks pending searches. Search callbacks route found cards through the same contact-created path used by observer changes. Completion decrements pending count and sends searchstatechange only after the final response; certificate failures have a separate exception flow. Current onSearchFinished became async and waits for exception dialog closure, so use current code when changing search lifecycle. This explains why search UI must not treat one directory callback as overall completion.
